# owner: platform
"""Seating charts: students in rows by last name."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student

# ---
def seating_rows(
    students: List[Student], seats: int
) -> List[str]:
    """One text line per row, sorted by last name."""
    if seats < 1:
        raise ValueError("seats per row must be positive")
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to seat")
    ordered = sorted(
        students,
        key=lambda item: (item.last_name, item.first_name)
    )
    lines = []
    for start in range(0, len(ordered), seats):
        chunk = ordered[start:start + seats]
        names = " | ".join(
            item.display_name for item in chunk
        )
        lines.append(f"Row {start // seats + 1}: {names}")
    return lines
